name: frontend-design

summary.en: Anthropic’s guidance for giving new or reworked interfaces a deliberate visual direction — typography, color and layout choices that avoid generic defaults.
summary.zh: Anthropic 出品的界面设计指引，帮助新界面或改版界面确立明确的视觉方向，在字体、配色和布局上避开千篇一律的默认样式。

upstreamDescription: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
